sanskrit_verse:
ताडनं बन्धनं चैव तथैव च विडन्नकम् ।
एष दण्डो हि शूद्रस्य नार्थदण्डो बृहस्पतिः ॥
transliteration:
tāḍanaṃ bandhanaṃ caiva tathaiva ca viḍannakam /
eṣa daṇḍo hi śūdrasya nārthadaṇ्डo bṛhaspatiḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Striking, binding, and public humiliation constitute the corrective measure for one who has acted without capacity; there is no financial penalty for the Śūdra, declares Bṛhaspati.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from realized consciousness, not social position
Causation arises from misaligned action rooted in unawakened state
Capacity-based responsibility determines the form of correction
Restoration logic aligns consequence directly with the nature of the act
Consciousness alignment supersedes all external punitive structures
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor lacks awakened capacity AND causes disruption THEN apply corrective alignment through sensory feedback
IF social identity invoked without inner realization THEN enforce completion via containment and reflection
IF violation occurs due to unconscious impulse THEN initiate exposure to collective witnessing as catalyst for awakening
EXCLUDE financial restitution IF root cause is absence of self-governance
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that the threshold of responsibility lies in the degree of conscious participation. Where a being acts without awakened awareness, the court must execute correction through containment and reflective confrontation rather than monetary extraction. Authority resides solely in those whose actions stem from sustained realization.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that misdeeds arise from absence of svadharma-siddhi. The sequential manifestation follows: lack of realization → unconscious impulse → disruptive act. Therefore, proportional response requires correction at the level of perception, not infliction. This upholds non-punitive reality by ensuring consequences serve awakening, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sensory recalibration through controlled impact to body-awareness
Enforce temporary spatial limitation to induce internal reflection
Apply public acknowledgment protocol to activate shame-to-insight transition
Assign completion process under supervision until integrity reemerges
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds from the Source-consciousness alone. Dharma stands restored when correction serves awakening. Reality remains non-punitive where consciousness reigns as sole arbiter.
